---
name: Feature request
about: Propose something new, or a change to how something works
title: ""
labels: enhancement
---

**What problem does this solve?**
Describe the situation where the current behavior falls short, not just the feature you have in mind — there may be a simpler way to solve the same problem.

**What would you like to happen?**

**Have you looked at how this fits the existing design?**
If your proposal touches routing, the tool system, sessions, or the approval flow, a quick look at the relevant page in [`docs/`](../../docs/) or [`ARCHITECTURE.md`](../../ARCHITECTURE.md) will help you (and reviewers) see whether it fits cleanly or needs a bigger discussion.

**Would you be willing to work on this yourself?**
Not required — just helps us plan. See [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](../../CONTRIBUTING.md) for the difference between a small PR you can just open and a larger change worth discussing here first.
